create_rt_detr_image_processor: create an RT-DETR image processor with configurable annotation format and normalization settings
build_rt_detr_annotations: build COCO detection annotations into RT-DETR target format with bounding boxes and class labels
test_rt_detr_resize_annotation: test resizing RT-DETR annotations including boxes, area, and masks to target dimensions
run_rt_detr_preprocess: run preprocessing on RT-DETR images with optional annotation conversion, resizing, padding, and normalization
review_rt_detr_post_process: review post-processing of RT-DETR object detection outputs into final bounding boxes with score thresholding
